items: More providers
Add as many model providers as you like (Ollama, LM Studio, Unsloth Studio, llama.cpp, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible server) and pick any of their models from one menu.
Ollama setup any time
"Set up Ollama" is now always in the providers screen.
Lighter while playing
Qwen3.5 4B is the recommended model while gaming, and Ollama frees GPU memory 3 minutes after an answer.
Cleaner panel
No more strip between the page and the assistant panel.
Matchups
Ask who counters a champion or how a matchup goes (e.g. Yasuo vs Annie); win rates from op.gg.
Pro play
Team results, upcoming matches and what pros played, from Leaguepedia.
Game know-how
Questions about waves, recalls, vision, objectives, team fights and more are answered from built-in notes.
Strongest picks per role
The strongest champions now come as the top 3 of every role, including ADC.
Faster answers
When the assistant needs several lookups, it does them at the same time.
Clearer errors
When your model server is off, the assistant says so instead of "fetch failed".
Assistant in game
Chat with the assistant in the overlay: click the box or press Ctrl+Shift+Space, Enter to send. Turn on In-Game Assistant in settings.
Augment help
In ARAM Mayhem and Arena, "Ask about these augments" reads the choice on your screen and shows how often each is picked on your champion.
Augments by pick rate
Mayhem and Arena augments are now shown by pick rate only, as Riot's rules require.
Easy setup
No model yet? The assistant panel installs Ollama and a model for you in one click, or gives you the commands.
Better answers
Build, item and pick questions always use live data now.
AI Assistant

A side panel on every page (drag its edge to resize). Ask about builds, picks, players, patch changes or your last game; it looks everything up live. Works with Ollama or your own server; pick the model in the chat box.
In-game win chance
Your team's estimated chance to win, every 3 minutes, from a model trained on real games. Turn it on in settings.
In-game build & lane info
Next item to buy (and one against their team after your core build), which skill to level, CS and gold vs your lane opponent, enemy ranks. Turn it on in settings.
Separate overlay windows
Each overlay part is its own small window you can move and collapse.
Bigger match history
Match rows now show your lane on the champion icon, items, your AI-Score place and both teams; the opened scoreboard lists everyone with spells, runes and rank.
Sidebar refresh
Champion stats get Total / Ranked Solo / Ranked Flex tabs, and Recently Played With shows everyone from your recent games.
onetricks look
Matches use the onetricks colors with a win or loss strip on the right.
Game results right away
The post-game card now shows the moment the game ends, from the end-of-game screen, instead of waiting for the match history.
Readable names
Recently played with shows full names, with the tag on a second line.
ARAM Mayhem and Arena
New tabs on build pages: op.gg core build, summoner spells, skill order and the champion's augments by tier (S+ to C), with a rarity filter.
Lane guesses
In champion select, unknown lanes are guessed from each champion's play rates. Click a lane to change it; Build vs follows your pick.
Names in game
In ranked games the lobby panel now shows every player's name and rank.
Post-game result everywhere
Right after a game a small result card shows on any page; Details opens the full card.
Recently played with
Summoner shows the players you met most in recent games, with your record with and against them.
Summoner, always fresh
Shows deeplol's real update time and refreshes data older than 5 minutes by itself.
Ranks and season stats
Solo and Flex ranks with W/L and peak, a 30-day LP chart and your season champions.
Match details
Each match opens Scoreboard, Build (purchase timeline, skill order, runes) and Win chance tabs.
Search from the header
Summoner search with region picker in the header; champion icons open their onetricks build.
Start screen
Your League account and the best one-tricks of your three most played champions.
onetricks look
Plain onetricks background when no wallpaper is saved, and the same header shadow.
Post-game card
After a game, the build page shows the result, LP change, KDA, CS, damage, gold and your items next to the most common one-trick core build.
Start with League, fixed
OTP Client is no longer added to Windows startup. A tiny watcher (about 4 MB) opens OTP Client when the League client starts; closing OTP Client really closes it.
Faster update restart
After you press Restart, the app closes right away so the update installs sooner. You will notice it from the next update on.
Start with League
New setting: OTP Client starts hidden with Windows and opens when the League client starts. Closing the window keeps it in the tray (right-click the tray icon to quit).
Tidier navigation
Back / forward / reload sit right under the header on build pages.
Lobby panel
In champion select and in game, the build page shows both teams: rank, win rate on their pick over the last 20 games, and OTP / 1st time badges. Click an enemy for the build vs that champion.
Your lane, your opponent
Champion select opens the build for your assigned lane. In game, Auto Matchup (Settings) switches to the build vs your lane opponent.
Match Search
Filter recent high-elo games by lane opponent, laning at 15, runes, spells, items, game length, rank, region and result. Button on the filter row.
Back to your champion
A chip next to the logo shows your pick (and your opponent once known); click it to get back to the build.
Back, forward, reload
Navigation buttons in the top-left corner of onetricks pages.
Cleaner pages
onetricks Pro-only parts are hidden unless your account has Pro, and the Tier List / Summoner / Wallpapers pages use the onetricks logo.
Silent updates
After you press Restart, the update installs without showing the installer and the app reopens on the new version.
Cleaner scrollbars
Scrollbars have no background anymore and start below the header, so they stay clear of the window buttons.
Same look everywhere
Tier List, Summoner, Wallpapers and their inner lists use the same thin scrollbar.
Check for updates
Settings has a new Updates section: see your version and check for updates yourself.
Update progress on the gear
While an update downloads, the settings button turns into a progress ring with the percentage; green means ready, restart from Settings.
Settings everywhere
The settings button is now on every onetricks page, including champion builds.
Move the window from build pages
The header on champion build pages can be used to drag the window again.
Tidier tier list
Column headers line up with their values (Win %, Pick %, Ban %, Games).
Game clicks fixed
The spell timer overlay no longer blocks the game: it only takes clicks while the cursor is over the panel.
Current spell icons
Spell icons and cooldowns match the live game (e.g. Heal and Exhaust 240 s).
In-game spell timers
Click an enemy Flash, Ignite and others to time them; right-click resets. Turn on in settings (In-Game Spell Timers).
Only over League
The overlay shows only while the game window is in front and follows it across monitors.
Easier clicks
The timer panel always takes clicks, bigger icons, drag it anywhere.
No ultimate timers
Enemy ultimate timers are removed: Riot no longer allows them in third-party apps.
What's new
This pop-up appears once after each update.
Auto update
New versions download in the background and ask to restart.
Current patch builds
Imports use the newest patch instead of the whole-season average.
Full tier list
Every champion, the live patch, D+/D- tiers and the real game count.
Wallpapers
Pick the splash arts you like; blur and darkness are adjustable.
Native window
The onetricks header is the title bar and stays on top while scrolling.
Faster summoner lookup
Profiles and matches load in parallel.
Tidy rune pages
Only one OTP rune page is kept; old ones are removed.
Fewer ads
Ad and tracking requests are blocked.
